description.de: Automatisierung von Downloads für IRC-Ankündigungen und RSS-Feeds: Filtert Releases in Echtzeit und übergibt Torrents direkt an Transmission. Braucht den Dienst „autobrr-daemon“.
description.en: Download automation for IRC announces and RSS feeds: filters releases in real time and sends torrents directly to Transmission. Needs the service “autobrr-daemon”.
description.pt: Automação de downloads para anúncios IRC e feeds RSS: filtra releases em tempo real e envia torrents diretamente ao Transmission. Requer o serviço “autobrr-daemon”.
